articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor basically gift-wrapped AWS GovCloud keys and internal secrets on GitHub for the world to see. The cybersecurity agency securing cybersecurity couldn't secure their own shit — poetry in motion.

articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: Congress finally noticed CISA's epic GitHub fuckup and wants answers. When lawmakers are demanding explanations about your data leak, you know someone's getting fired.

articles.title: Cybersecurity Evolution: How We Went From Perimeter Defense to AI-Native Security
articles.summary: AI is now cranking out exploits faster than your vulnerability scanner can say 'oh fuck.' The robots aren't coming for our jobs — they're coming for our unpatched systems first.

articles.title: Privacy commissioner to monitor security upgrades after Manage My Health hack
articles.summary: Trend Micro Apex One got pwned via zero-day path traversal, now CISA's waving red flags. Because nothing says 'cybersecurity vendor' like getting actively exploited in the wild.

articles.title: 3 SOC Steps that Shut Down Incident Risks Early

articles.title: State Cyber Leaders Beg Congress for More Funding, Support
